message: Startup resolved project mdm-mydefrag-syntax; queue resolver returned Idle. Direct ad hoc defect framed for approval: prevent existing-record overwrite, update candidate status correctly, and suppress the accepted-for-translation banner after catalog edits.
User authorized execution with Do now and added that editing stops working after a number of updates.

Windows computer-use bootstrap failed because its Node runtime path was unavailable. Used an isolated Electron instance through Chromium CDP; the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 setting was cleared only for diagnostic launches.

A 16-Apply pre-fix live baseline showed status writes themselves preserved all 607 existing records. The actual Add failure was repeated JSON array properties receiving the same suggested key; the first add could succeed and later adds collided. Status filtering set hidden correctly, but candidate-choice-row display:grid overrode hidden.

JSON suggestions now include stable array-item identity and avoid occupied keys. Existing catalog keys are immutable in both renderer and service. Catalog candidate and record statuses are labeled separately, pending-source warnings are candidate-scoped and reworded, and candidate filter rows now hide with one-line controls.
npm run test:language-app passed 79/79; npm run test:locale-app passed 35/35; JavaScript syntax checks and git diff checks passed.

Patched live workflow filtered 505 rows to 285 Rejected rows with zero vertical control offset; added three distinct command-title records including one after six edits; draft catalog grew 607 to 610 while all 607 baseline records remained identical; visible statuses refreshed and existing keys were read-only.

The live draft was reverted to No unsaved changes, diagnostic keys and probe text were absent from canonical/generated data, and the diagnostic app closed. Pre-existing canonical catalog and candidate-status worktree changes were not modified by the diagnostic workflow.

Repaired cumulative Catalog Add/Edit behavior, protected existing catalog identities, restored functional one-line status filtering, clarified status and source-pending UI, and verified repeated live operations without persisting diagnostic changes.
